_doc: rttools.wcet spec of CAR-full on images/tt-rc7/car_full.elf (car_full.c with the time-triggered injection, INJECTION=tt, riscv64-elf-gcc 12.2.0; images/tt/BUILD.txt). A job runs from the return of ucx_task_yield in wait_release to its next call: one call of begin_marks (ITER_BEGIN and the read markers) and one ITER_END in run_task.
